scenario_rules.note: Stop-Sign: default goal and default success, plus stop_infraction when the ego crosses the line without 3 s below 0.3 m/s first. The check is SKIPPED, not passed, on a trace with no approach to the line.

termination.detail: off drivable for 0.5 s through frame 114

channels.source: contact kinds rear_end/angle/sideswipe, or the evaluator's collision count
frames the evaluator's TL column flagged as a red-light violation (not the rubric comply() predicate)

notes: efficiency not reported: background traffic median 0.32 m/s is below the 1.5 m/s floor (or no checkpoint had moving traffic), so the ratio has no denominator — this scenario cannot measure efficiency, it is not a slow policy
stop sign: trace carries no approach to the stop line (no dist_to_stopline_m > 0 on a scored frame)
scored window is 9.5 s but t_max is 60.0 s — no policy was tested against its budget here; run with --eval-frames 600 or declare the window as the budget

metrics.json, driving_score_summary.csv and run_meta.json were pruned after scoring (--navsafe-prune-artifacts); re-scoring this directory loses the per-frame EPDMS flags (contacts fall back to the run total) and the TL column the red_light channel is measured from
